job: My mother lives alone and can't bend down any more. The TV remote is on the low footstool by her bed and there is a towel on the edge of the bath, please pick both up. Fetch her pill organiser from the kitchen counter and wipe her bedside table.
understood_as: Help an elderly woman who can't bend: pick up her TV remote from the low bedroom footstool and the towel from the bath edge, bring her pill organiser from the kitchen counter, and wipe her bedside table.
steps: Wipe the bedside table with a cloth so it is clean first.
Pick up the TV remote from the low footstool by her bed.
Go to the bathroom and pick up the towel from the edge of the bath.
Go to the kitchen, pick up the pill organiser from the counter and bring it to her.
Where each item ends up still needs your answer (see questions).

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern for covering the bedside table without knocking things off.
Shows how firmly to hold the cloth and press so it doesn't slip or drag items.
Shows how to reach down to the low footstool and lift the remote.
The remote is small and smooth, so grip force matters to stop it slipping or pressing buttons.
Shows how to gather the towel off the bath edge without it falling into the bath.
Soft fabric can slip out of a light grip, so the right squeeze must be shown.
Shows how to lift the organiser off the counter and keep it level while carrying.
Too hard a grip can crack it or pop the lids open and spill pills.

questions: The robot has no 'put down' or 'hand over' skill and no destination has been located: where should the remote, the towel and the pill organiser end up (e.g. on the bedside table, in a towel rail, handed to her)? Please mark those places so they can be added.
The only towel card describes a hand towel bunched on the floor; is the towel on the bath edge a similar hand towel, or a larger bath towel that needs its own card?
Where is the cloth for wiping kept? Its location hasn't been marked, so please point it out or leave one on the bedside table.
Is the bedside table delicate (e.g. polished wood) or does it hold anything fragile, so we know how hard to press when wiping?
